Exercise: One Half Locust

Category:
stretching

Exercise Type:
None

Force Type:
static

Difficulty Level:
beginner

Movement Patterns:

- unilateral_isometric_contraction

Primary Muscles:

- quadriceps

Secondary Muscles:

- abdominals
- biceps
- chest

Equipment:
None

Fatigue Score:
2

Systemic Fatigue:
low

Stimulus To Fatigue Ratio:
0.8

Energy Requirement:
low to moderate

Recovery Time:
1 hours

Goals:

- core_engagement
- stretching

Contraindications:

- lower back pain

Exercise Variations:
None

Substitution Options:
None

Instructions:

- Lie facedown on the floor.
- Put your left hand under your left hipbone to pad your hip and pubic bone.
- Bend your right knee so you can hold the foot in your right hand.
- Lift the foot in the air and simultaneously lift your shoulders off the floor. This also stretches the right hip flexor and the chest and shoulders. Switch sides. If it doesn't bother your back, you can try it with both arms and legs at the same time.
